# Held toolpath gouge audit

Commit `793b490dd8` (dirty) · Apple M1 Max · recorded 2026-10-22T17:01:26+00:00.

A gouge is a path element whose swept tool disk leaves the analytic pocket: `dist(element, ∂P) < r`, decided exactly.
A touch is `dist == r` exactly (allowed). Depths are `r - dist`, reported as doubles; the split column counts gouges deeper than 1e-09 mm (reporting only, to compare with the 2026-10-17 Decimal audit).
Audit budget: 2 s per workload (audit clock only).
